Decision model | Version 1.0 | 26 August 2026 | AUD, ex GST | First three 12-month periods after commercial readiness

1. Positioning is credible: workflow-first systems around existing practice software, with privacy, data minimisation and human review.

2. Commercial readiness is not: the live contact form does not transmit leads, the brand is anonymous, proof is illustrative, analytics/CRM/scheduler are absent, and technical trust/SEO basics remain incomplete.

3. The current $950–$2,500 public starting prices do not fund the modeled full scopes. At Base Year 1 project volumes, modeled project gross margin is negative at reference pricing and about 60% at target pricing.

4. Near-term growth is capacity-constrained, not market-constrained. The Base case rises from about $182k to $486k, but delivery demand reaches about 1.9 FTE by Year 3.

Do not scale traffic into the current funnel. First repair lead capture and trust, then sell Heutrix Diagnostics, Heutrix Workflow Transformation and Heutrix AI Guardrails with honest founding-client terms and 30-day stabilisation where applicable. Keep the first vertical narrow, measure gross margin by product and scope variant, and hire only when signed backlog holds delivery utilisation above 85% for 8–12 weeks.

Model use

• Update blue cells only.
• Replace forecast assumptions with CRM and time-tracking actuals monthly.
• Treat Base as an operating plan, not a promise.
• Use Conservative for cash survival and Upside for capacity planning.
• All market sizing is sensitivity-based and intentionally avoids double counting.
